vibe_rationale: Authentic, long-running counterculture festival with a strong community core, but protest-first and rough-edged rather than curated or brand-friendly.
fit_notes: Adult, alternative-minded audience with a sponsor page and many local partners, but the link to wellness runs through the festival's law-reform framing rather than health services. Any brand presence would need to sit inside that community framing; it is an NSW event.
